questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in thegiven sentence.
I know you have been really busy with your work, but can you just give me a fewminutes?
questions.solution: C)Snowed under (phrase)– Really busy with work काम में डूबा हुआ

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
To make both ends meet
options: To take back what you have said
questions.solution: A)To make both ends meet(idiom) – To live within one’s income किसी तरह से गुज़ारा करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Rohit laid down his proposal, and told Rohit that the ball was now in his court.
options: It is Rohit's responsibility to take the next action or decision
He had to play the game and win the match
He had to continue the remaining time in court
The captaincy of the team was on his shoulders
questions.solution: A)The ball was now in his court(idiom) – it is his or her responsibility to take the next action or decision in a situation. अब उसका ज़िम्मेदारी है कि वह अगला कदम उठाए या निर्णय ले

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
I know you’re blaming me for all that has happened but I wasn’t at fault alone
options: it is always darkest before the dawn
make hay while the sun shines
questions.solution: A)It takes two to tango(idiom) – it means both parties involved in a situation are equally responsible.दोनोजिम्मेदारहैं/एकहाथसेतालीनहींबजती

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in thegiven sentence.
Sharon doing the work all by herself? Seems like it is possible, but is very unlikely to happen
questions.solution: D)pie in the sky(idiom) – Something that is promised but is very unlikely to be realized हवा में महल

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.
We should teach our wards not to look down upon anybody in human society.
questions.solution: A)Look down upon(idiom) – Despise somebody तुच्छ समझना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.
Everybody was surprised to see that he fell flat even after arduous efforts
questions.solution: A) Fell flat(idiom) – Fail to win applause सराहना प्राप्त करने में असफल

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
His old car has become a financial burden on him now.
questions.solution: B) ‘a financial burden'के बदले 'a white elephant' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'a white elephant' का मतलब है 'महंगा और रख-रखाव में मुश्किल', जो 'a financial burden' को सही से substitute करता है; जैसे— His old car has become a white elephant on him now.

questions.question:

Many unavoidable situations were avoided only because someone had our back
questions.solution:
C)To support- (had our back) - समर्थन देना.
